stories.title: Un chef de guerilla, lié à l'assassinat d'Uribe, tué lors d'une opération des forces de l'ordre en Colombie

en.title: Guerrilla leader linked to Uribe's assassination killed in Colombian police operation
en.summary: A dissident FARC faction leader known as Robinson Gutiérrez, accused of financing the assassination of Colombian presidential candidate Miguel Uribe in 2025, was killed during a law enforcement operation in Huila department.

stories.title: Nein zu Neutralitätsinitiative – SVP zeigt sich kämpferisch – SP will klare Kante zeigen

en.title: No to neutrality initiative – SVP takes fighting stance – SP wants to take clear position
en.summary: Following the failure of a neutrality initiative, the SVP plans to focus on an EU treaty package while the SP intends to adopt a distinct stance.

stories.title: Le nord-est des Etats-Unis frappé par une tempête rare pour la saison

en.title: Rare seasonal storm strikes northeastern United States
en.summary: A nor'easter storm brought heavy rainfall and strong winds to New York, Boston, and Philadelphia, causing at least one death and leaving over 100,000 people without power before weakening in the evening.

stories.title: In der russisch besetzten Frontstadt Oleschki gibt es weder Strom noch Gas – nun geht auch die Nahrung aus

en.title: Russian-occupied frontline city Oleshki has no electricity or gas – now running out of food
en.summary: Moscow is refusing to authorize a rescue operation for residents of the war-damaged city of Oleshki on the Dnipro River who are cut off and facing food shortages, with the last food delivery four months ago.

stories.title: Face à la menace d’un tremblement de terre dévastateur, la Suisse n’a toujours pas trouvé son filet de sécurité

en.title: Facing the threat of a devastating earthquake, Switzerland has still not found its safety net
en.summary: Switzerland lacks comprehensive earthquake insurance coverage despite the potential for major seismic events to cause tens of billions of francs in damage. Parliament is still determining how to finance potential losses from a major earthquake.

stories.title: Die Idee einer US-Militärbasis in Polen konkretisiert sich – Warschau will dafür Milliardenbeträge ausgeben

en.title: The idea of a US military base in Poland is taking concrete form – Warsaw wants to spend billions for it
en.summary: Poland and the United States are conducting detailed negotiations regarding the establishment and location of an American military base in Poland. The discussions are driven by growing security concerns related to Russia.

stories.title: «La neutralité n’est plus ce qu’elle était»: le vote sur l’initiative ce dimanche a été suivi de près par Moscou, qui s’est immiscé dans la campagne

en.title: "Neutrality is no longer what it was": Sunday's initiative vote was closely followed by Moscow, which interfered in the campaign
en.summary: Switzerland held a referendum on constitutional neutrality that attracted international attention, particularly from Russia and Ukraine as directly affected parties. The vote resulted in a decisive rejection with 70.2% voting against the measure.

stories.title: En Serbie, le président Aleksandar Vučić démissionne pour tenter de devenir premier ministre

en.title: In Serbia, President Aleksandar Vučić resigns to attempt to become prime minister
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić announced his resignation and will run for prime minister in October elections called after extensive protests and a train station canopy collapse.

stories.title: Le président serbe Aleksandar Vucic démissionne et brigue le poste de Premier ministre

en.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic Resigns and Runs for Prime Minister
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation and will seek the position of Prime Minister in legislative elections scheduled for October, which follow nearly two years of student-led protests.

stories.title: Cinq hommes suspectés de préparer «un acte terroriste» arrêtés près d’une base militaire anglaise

en.title: Five men suspected of preparing "a terrorist act" arrested near an English military base
en.summary: British police arrested five men overnight near Fairford air base in western England on suspicion of preparing a terrorist attack. The operation followed reports of suspicious vehicles heading toward the facility used by the US Air Force.

stories.title: Cinq hommes arrêtés pour préparation d'un "acte terroriste" près d'une base aérienne en Angleterre

en.title: Five men arrested for preparation of a "terrorist act" near an air base in England
en.summary: British counterterrorism police are investigating a major incident near a military base in western England used by the U.S. Air Force, where five men have been arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act.

stories.title: Berne rejette à près de 60% l'initiative visant à inscrire la formation dans la Constitution

en.title: Bern rejects nearly 60% initiative to enshrine education in Constitution
en.summary: Swiss voters in Bern rejected an initiative with 59.9% voting against enshrining education in the cantonal constitution, which would have required high-quality education guarantees throughout the region.

stories.title: Diesel wird immer teurer: Kommt nun der Durchbruch des Elektrolastwagens?

en.title: Diesel becomes more expensive: Is the breakthrough for electric trucks coming now?
en.summary: Mercedes and Volkswagen have struggled to convince companies to adopt electric trucks, but market conditions are shifting. Chinese competitors present a significant challenge to this emerging sector.

stories.title: «Guten Tag, Arbeitsmarktkontrolle»: An der Grenze zu Deutschland zeigt sich, worüber die Schweiz beim Lohnschutz mit der EU streitet

en.title: "Good day, labor market control": At the border with Germany, what Switzerland is disputing with the EU over wage protection becomes clear
en.summary: Switzerland's wage protection system shields workers and businesses from cheaper EU competition, but this protective measure frustrates Brussels and creates an unresolvable paradox in negotiations.

stories.title: Die Geschichte der Huthi: Wie aus einer lokalen Protestbewegung ein geopolitischer Machtfaktor wurde

en.title: The history of the Huthis: How a local protest movement became a geopolitical power factor
en.summary: Houthi militias now control one of the world's most important shipping routes and regularly attack Israel. The article examines the origins and backing of this Yemeni group.

stories.title: Boris Pistorius und der Abbruch des Projekts F126 – Wie aus sechs Fregatten zur U-Boot-Jagd ein Milliardenstreit wurde

en.title: Boris Pistorius and the cancellation of the F126 project – How six frigates for submarine hunting became a billion-euro dispute
en.summary: Germany planned to purchase its largest military ship in Bundeswehr history, but the defense minister abruptly halted the project this summer. The article examines the reasons behind this decision.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Die dystopischen Warnungen von Bill Gates bis Dario Amodei sind übertrieben – KI verspricht eine bessere Zukunft

en.title: COMMENTARY - The dystopian warnings from Bill Gates to Dario Amodei are exaggerated – AI promises a better future
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is spreading rapidly across the economy and society, exhibiting characteristics of a new industrial revolution. Despite challenges and risks, the commentary suggests all will ultimately benefit from AI's advancement.
